spanish: Y dijo Moisés a Aarón: Toma una jarra, y da allí lleno del ómer man, y depónlo delante de Jehová a guarda a generaciones de ustedes.

findings.issue: man leaves the common noun מָן (H4478, not a proper name) untranslated as the Hebrew lemma.

notes: Imperatives stay 2ms and the 2mp suffix stays ustedes; other tokens are licensed.
